terra.problem: Eliphaz says Job withheld water and food; he does not say that nothing was sold.
Referring to the next card breaks the rule against talking about the lesson itself.
The verse does not say the widows and fatherless had no one to stand up for them.
The comparison with merchants makes light of the accusation that widows were sent away without help.
The explanation makes Eliphaz the speaker of the question ‘What does God know?’ Eliphaz attributes that question to Job.
The men told God to depart; the passage does not say they actually sent Him away.
The passage does not say God filled their houses after they told Him to depart.
